name: workflow-value-toolkit
description: Eight skills for choosing model, reasoning effort, and speed at the best-value point before diminishing returns, with six priority presets and an optional conversational direction check.

interface.longDescription: Choose a practical model, reasoning effort, and speed configuration for the task. Includes a shared workflow check, all six orderings of cost, quality, and speed, and an explicitly activated direction-change check for the current chat. Offers Apply suggested settings or Keep current settings after a recommendation, using supported host controls or manual guidance. Reuses evidence, preserves required quality, and distinguishes recommendations from verified settings. No background service, polling, MCP connection, or automatic global-setting changes.
defaultPrompt: Choose the best-value model, reasoning effort, and speed for this task.
Reevaluate this workflow with quality first, cost second, and speed third.
Enable lightweight direction-change checks for this chat only.
